'''2003 World Championship Day 2 Jonny Chu LS Local Uprising (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2003 World Championship]] (Day 2); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Jonathan "jonnychu" Chu (2003-09-15).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=30314 Chu's Speeder Pile]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050517230733/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=30314&PHPSESSID=...328fedb22570524062aeb1303 Internet Archive]</ref>
